author: Hero Hei
description:
Highguard has officially been out for 24 hours now and the spiral downwards continues as player retention continues to plummet. Even more hilarious, corporate journalists are seething at how gamers have rejected the game. They want to blame gamers for not supporting the game while they deflect from the real issues going on, and the pathetic state of the Western AAA industry. Lastly, Geoff Keighley, despite doing his best to promote Highguard, was met with a hilarious turn of events in response to his incessant shilling.
